subject: chemistry
title: Bohr model & hydrogen spectrum
description: Electron jumps n₂ → n₁ emit a photon: 1/λ = R Z²(1/n₁² − 1/n₂²). Balmer lines are visible.

subject: chemistry
title: Electron configuration (Aufbau, Hund, Pauli)
description: Orbital box diagram for Z = 1–54 with Cr, Cu, Mo, Ag exceptions.

subject: chemistry
title: Shapes of atomic orbitals
description: 1: s · 2–4: p_x, p_y, p_z · 5: d_xy · 6: d_xz · 7: d_x²−y² · 8: d_z². Rotate to see 3D lobes and phases.

subject: chemistry
title: Periodic table & periodic trends
description: Categories or heat maps of electronegativity, ionisation energy and atomic radius (Z ≤ 36).

subject: chemistry
title: Trend graph across periods
description: Bars of the chosen property for Z = 1–36; note the peaks at noble gases and dips at alkali metals.

subject: chemistry
title: Moles, molar mass & Avogadro number
description: n = m / M and N = n·Nₐ for a sample of an element.

subject: chemistry
title: VSEPR molecular shapes
description: 13 shapes from linear to octahedral with lone pairs and bond angles; rotate in 3D.

subject: chemistry
title: Bond polarity & ionic character
description: ΔEN between two atoms; % ionic ≈ 100(1 − e^(−ΔEN²/4)) (Pauling).

subject: chemistry
title: Gas laws  PV = nRT
description: Charles (V ∝ T), Boyle (V ∝ 1/P) and Avogadro (V ∝ n) in a piston.

subject: chemistry
title: Maxwell–Boltzmann speed distribution
description: f(v) at two temperatures; hotter gas spreads to higher speeds, peak at v_mp = √(2RT/M).

subject: chemistry
title: Real gas: van der Waals isotherm
description: P = RT/(V − b) − a/V² compared with the ideal gas (CO₂ default a, b).

subject: chemistry
title: Graham's law of diffusion
description: Rate ∝ 1/√M: lighter gases spread faster along the tube.

subject: chemistry
title: Energy profile: exo/endothermic & catalyst
description: ΔH = E(products) − E(reactants); activation energy Eₐ and the lower catalysed path.

subject: chemistry
title: Gibbs free energy & spontaneity
description: ΔG = ΔH − TΔS; the reaction becomes (non-)spontaneous at T = ΔH/ΔS.

subject: chemistry
title: Heating water (calorimetry, engine)
description: dT/dt = P/(mc); temperature plateaus at the boiling point.

subject: chemistry
title: First-order reaction A → B (engine)
description: d[A]/dt = −k[A]; half-life t½ = ln 2/k is constant.

subject: chemistry
title: Zero, first & second order rate laws
description: d[A]/dt = −k[A]ⁿ; compare [A], ln[A] and 1/[A] for the straight-line test.

subject: chemistry
title: Arrhenius equation
description: k = A e^(−Eₐ/RT); a 10 K rise roughly doubles k for typical Eₐ.

subject: chemistry
title: A + B → C (second order, engine)
description: d[C]/dt = k[A][B]; the limiting reagent runs out first.

subject: chemistry
title: Reversible reaction A ⇌ B (engine)
description: Forward and backward rates become equal; Q → K = k_f/k_b.

subject: chemistry
title: Le Chatelier's principle (add reactant)
description: At time t₁ extra A is added; the system shifts forward to restore Q = K.

subject: chemistry
title: ICE table: H₂ + I₂ ⇌ 2HI
description: Solves (2x)² / ((a − x)(b − x)) = K for the equilibrium amounts.

subject: chemistry
title: pH scale & universal indicator
description: Strong acid or base of concentration C (water autoionisation included).

subject: chemistry
title: Acid–base titration
description: NaOH from the burette into acid: strong (HCl) or weak (CH₃COOH, pKa 4.76) titration curve and indicator colour.

subject: chemistry
title: Buffer: Henderson–Hasselbalch
description: pH = pKa + log([A⁻]/[HA]); the buffer works best near pH = pKa.

subject: chemistry
title: Daniell cell & Nernst equation
description: Zn | Zn²⁺ ‖ Cu²⁺ | Cu: E = E° − (RT/2F) ln([Zn²⁺]/[Cu²⁺]); electrons flow Zn → Cu.

subject: chemistry
title: Electrolysis: Faraday's laws
description: Mass deposited m = M·I·t / (z·F); copper plates the cathode.
